Basic chat completion against real Google Gemini API

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.literllm.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var requestJson = "{\"max_tokens\":10,\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Say hello in exactly one word.\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gemini/gemini-2.5-flash-lite\"}";
        var request = JsonUtil.fromJson(requestJson, ChatCompletionRequest.class);
        var apiKey = System.getenv("GEMINI_API_KEY");
        if (apiKey == null || apiKey.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalStateException("GEMINI_API_KEY must be set");
        try (var client = LiterLlm.createClient(apiKey, null, null, null, null)) {
        var result = client.chat(request);
        System.out.println(result.choices());
        System.out.println(result.usage());
        }
    }
}
```
